deadline.value: Apply by December 15 to be considered for fellowship support for fall entry.
deadline.quote: Those seeking fall admission with possible fellowship support are encouraged to complete their applications by December 15.

gre_subject.value: The pages checked do not mention the Mathematics GRE.

supervisor.value: The Graduate Programs Committee reviews applications; new students get a temporary advisor in their first year.
supervisor.quote: The Committee reviews applications for admission to the program, awards financial support and evaluates student progress | New students will be advised during their first year by a temporary advisor.

funding.value: PhD students in good standing are supported as teaching assistants with tuition and fees paid for the first 11 semesters, plus guaranteed first-year summer support.
funding.quote: Ph.D. students in good standing in the department are supported via Graduate Teaching Assistantships, which include department payment of tuition and required fees | Summer support is guaranteed the first year

entry_route.value: You can enter the PhD with or without a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: The Mathematics Department covers University tuition and fees for Ph.D. students in good standing during the first 11 semesters (not counting summer semesters) independently if the Ph.D. student has a MS degree or not.

notes: PhD also offered as an Interdisciplinary track. All applicants are automatically considered for departmental support.
